items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Yeah, Tyler McCurdy. Yeah, Tyler McCurdy. And he was, he was a professor, Tyler, and he could play... Oh, but if he played soft, we, we could hear him.
